scripts.postbuild: node -e "const f=require('fs');const o='public/ota-version.json';if(f.existsSync(o)){f.copyFileSync(o,'build/ota-version.json');console.log('[postbuild] ota-version copied')};const a='android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk';if(f.existsSync(a)){const d='releases';f.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});f.copyFileSync(a,d+'/WeChat-v2.0.apk');console.log('[postbuild] APK copied to releases/')}else{console.log('[postbuild] No APK found, skipping')}"
